cognitive_capacity.rationale: Every task asks a first-grade learner to read or set one clock time using only whole, half, or quarter-hour positions, with no extraneous computation.

competency_alignment.rationale: The stems and analog-clock interactions directly assess reading and writing time at the hour, half hour, and quarter hour named by this competency.

competency_fulfillment.rationale: Across the packet, learners both identify displayed times and set requested times, including hour, half-hour, and quarter-hour examples on an analog clock.

decomposition.reasoning: The six printed requirements separately cover reading and writing, time, each required interval, and the analog-clock representation without omitting or adding a competency element.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: Samples include reading and setting exact hours, half hours, quarter past, and quarter before times, with varied hour values including 12 and 11.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: The language is short and concrete, and the single-clock interaction keeps the perceptual and response demands appropriate for Grade 1 Quarter 4.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Both read multiple-choice and set fill-in-blank variants occur, and the interval cases are distributed across the two interaction modes.
